rationale: The assistant correctly identified water-cooled condenser drying as the normal explanation, matching the hidden truth, and hedged appropriately with 'very likely normal' rather than certainty. It gave sensible, ordered leak checks (puddles, idle running, wet clothes) and realistic UK cost context, without recommending any part or inventing evidence. The only minor weakness is the water-meter check, which the customer would have declined, and that the make/model request came at the end rather than being used to confirm the design; otherwise an exemplary single-turn resolution.
